comment: Context assumptions: In a care setting, such as Long term Care spanning years across multiple organisations mostly including care at home, where those organisations are too small/fragmented to understand how to manage their integration suppliers and insufficiently capable on information governance as a core skill (instead emphasising care and clinical skills over digital). Empowering patients through this same architectural semantic model should be covered, especially in the consent management and governance sections.
